这次我非骂你们不可。原版那些被不同武器击杀后风格迥异的单位死亡动画被你们当早饭吃了？ 被箭射飞的阿拉伯剑士呢？被链锤兵爆头打掉头盔的阿拉伯弓箭手呢？那些令人印象深刻的死亡动画统统不见了。取而代之的是粗糙的、而且相似度高的死亡动画，都特么可以拿去搞“大家来找不同”了。 更糟糕的是，原版的那些单位，看得出来死亡动画都是量身定做的，而所谓决定版中的死亡动画明显是套用了1-2个模板，去看看阿拉伯剑士和欧洲剑士的死亡动画，一个模子里刻出来。 你们还有脸大言不惭地在纪录片中说，自己尽最大努力保留了原版的魅力。我呸。 这个问题在要塞决定版中就出现了，但那个版本单位数量少，所以并不凸显（最搞笑的事，本来demo版里剑士被钝器击杀有一个仰面躺下的动作，结果正式版里被负优化掉了，导致三种击杀动作几乎看不出区别，我问了无数次原因，你们这帮家伙从来不回答）。现在好了，加了一大堆新兵种后，这个问题变得无比刺眼。2年来，我通过各种渠道给你们指出好多次，但你们都装聋作哑，懒惰、傲慢又愚蠢。 就这样敷衍了事是吧？那好，差评奉上。 比起那些狗屎DLC，你不应该先把这个问题修复了么？ New death animations and death poses suck donkey ball. They are too similar that can join the game of"spot the difference". Do you forget how distinct they used to be in the OG? And you call this "maintain the charm of the OG"? I can't even count how many times I've given my suggestion on that since the release of SDE(Funny thing is, you've made a good and distinct death animation and pose of swordman in demo,which is laying on his back when killed by mace, then deleted it in the full version). But you devs just play blind and deaf. You ruined my childhood, I hand you a thumb -down as a gift. Please take it and you're welcome. People are leaving the castle.Instead of making ♥♥♥♥♥♥ dlcs, I prefer you revamp the animations first.
系列老用户，这次挺失望。首发质量不怎么样。复杂的UI，莫名的遭遇战模式，在地图列表无法正确选择地图。暂时不推荐。

最后一次玩这个游戏，在自己老家的空调房里，下午太阳很大，初中的假期，慵懒、疲惫、惬意，打开这个游戏建造一个无敌的城堡，包着ai围而不打享受凌虐，可以度过一个极好的下午，要是爸妈出去了，这个电脑能开一晚上，地图已经被榨满，拥挤指数也都-6还是-8，地图上一半是花园一半是刑具，很是怀念； 人如果这辈子都在花剩下的时间追寻童年，想想也是挺感伤的，在这种惆怅的氛围下，突然觉得游戏中的各个领主都变得亲切了很多，再打开时，已经是对曾经无限的追念了。 很难想象，那个下午之后，我再也没有打开过这款游戏，时隔了快二十年，十字军又重新出现在了我的电脑里，仿佛一扇时光之门连接了过往，带给我的回忆是如此的独特，以至于映入我眼前的画面，是电脑玩太久之后，老妈给削的水果、泡的茶，或是开学之后，跟好朋友津津乐道讨论这个游戏的时光。 再过个十几年，也许又会有其他回忆再次把我链回这个社畜的晚上，未来的我到时候也会怀念现在的我，这真的是经典游戏最大的魅力了。 游戏里有两句台词一直萦绕在记忆中，一直没听清楚说的啥。。。 一个是阿拉伯剑士的“猛来”.... 一个是无法建造的配音，断句奇奇怪怪，总感觉是"cant place , down my lord " 不过第二句，总感觉十几年前说的是"cant place it here, dear my lord" 想想自己dna里被刻了两句这种怪东西，真有意思吧~

I really wanted to love this. As a long-time fan of Stronghold Crusader, I came in hoping for a worthy modern take one that respected the original but brought meaningful improvements to the table. What we got instead feels like a mixed bag at best: part quality-of-life update, part ghost of the past, and part haunted house full of 20-year-old bugs that just refuse to die. Yes, there are some QoL improvements: auto-trading, builders no longer moonwalking to siege weapons, and a few stubborn bugs finally laid to rest. But for every step forward, the game seems to take two awkward steps back usually into a bonfire where a worker is permanently stuck. The AI, supposedly improved, is often laughably worse. Lords now sit in their shiny new castles hoarding gold like medieval crypto bros, refusing to launch actual attacks. And when they do, their tactics still make you wonder if they’re trying to win... or auditioning for a blooper reel. Pathfinding? Still tragic. Ballistas? Still drunk. Lancers? Still jogging like they're on a casual Sunday walk (unless you mod them). And the new javelin unit? Well… let's just say it's not winning any popularity contests in the barracks. Graphically, it’s subjective. Some might like the updated look, but many models feel AI-upscaled and lack the charm of the pixelated grit we grew up with. The new UI gives off mobile game vibes — and not in a good way. There are some bright spots: the co-op mode is fun, and the few new units and content do add a hint of freshness. But none of it really sticks. It’s like putting a fresh coat of paint on a castle with structural damage looks okay from afar, but step inside and you’ll still fall through the same broken floorboards. Verdict? At this price, it doesn’t justify the title of “Definitive Edition.” If you’re a veteran, stick with the HD version and the community patch. It plays better, feels better, and won’t leave you wondering why a 2025 release still suffers from 2002’s bugs.

这什么二十年前的古董游戏？真是狗都不—— [h3] 玩！玩得就是古董游戏！[/h3] 属于是非常原汁原味还原20年前古董游戏的一作，回来了都回来了！ 本作引入了双人对战AI模式，属于是非常适合拉朋友入坑的一作。 另外新增了新领主、新单位、新战役——真是最温故知新的一集！ 操作手感、单位贴图、高低视觉差等等，比起HD改善了很多很多很多。 游戏百科中完善了很多词条，而且全部都有百分百汉化，非常的加分！（比如这次就让我重新认识到了礼拜堂-教堂-大教堂的根本区别） 尽管如此，AI确实是没有任何改进。生产单位和战斗单位的智障寻路，智障队友的弱智开局，以及智障敌人的固定开局……可以说这20年来就AI方面，真的是完全没有进步。某种意义上而言，也确实是原汁原味了。（尤其是老鼠公爵，无敌智障Plus） PS. 开局时，一定一定一定记住要先把游戏速度调慢！！！！不然真的直接爆炸！！！ [h3]PS2. 火弩车有BUG！[/h3] 如果隔城墙或者隔着任何不可通过的障碍时，点击进攻，火弩车不会绕道，反而会不停地进行“上箭-发射-箭矢消失-上箭”的循环，看起来非常鬼畜。 PS3. 难以置信。这游戏的安利难度竟然远超其他同类游戏。给男朋友安利这游戏简直非了牛劲……硬送都不要。为什么啊！！！
更新后，打开任务、征程、对战、编辑器都闪退（教程不会，多人没试过 发现原因是360发现木马HEUR/QVM202.0.1DE0.Malware.Gen，把Vuplex WebView.vuplex文件删除了 解决方法是，玩游戏时关闭360；开游戏前，要么360恢复被删文件，要么Steam直接验证完整性；或者，在运行前，先添加到360信任区。至于是否真是木马，我也不确定

我只感觉到了气愤，各种BUG满天飞，也不抓紧修复，都2025年了，老版本的东西问题也没解决不说，2025年该有的操作和修改也没有，还卖76，萤火虫的敷衍和懒惰展现的淋漓尽致 1.巨火弩进不去墙 2.部队被选中后走了以后会突然莫名其妙走回来 3.还是会卡农民，在大本营这里卡在那边不出去，点击会说赶往工作岗位，都不知道是哪个地方卡的,像要塞传奇有暂停一个建筑还是所有建筑的选项，还可以筛选看一下，你这个所谓的决定版，连这个都做不到，决定你吗逼呢？导致建筑一睡就全睡，我日你吗萤火虫，就这还决定版，决定你吗的逼。 4.2025了还做不到一键更换武器制作和解除人口上限吗？是现在的电脑带不动你这个游戏吗？ 5.塔楼部队一多不给放攻城器械，我走了之后可以放但是部队还是可以重叠，你搞这么个特性恶心玩家干什么呢？ 6.汉化一坨答辩，对中国玩家的敷衍令人愤怒，原版很多就有的汉化搬都不会搬吗？ 7.动不动存档消失，游戏无法加载，但是文件打开有是怎么回事？可以解释吗？玩个即时战略花几十分钟玩了退出下一次再来玩和我说存档没了，搞笑呢？ 8.部队动画一坨屎，刺客走路跟猥琐男一样，没有一点刺客的感觉，只有小偷的感觉，剑士走路和街头的精神小伙一样，没有一点剑士的感觉，走路直起来，然后宝剑乱挥，不如原版有气势，反倒就像街溜子，就像精神小伙挥舞着甩棍然后大摇大摆的走过来一样。奴隶更是跑不起来了，萤火虫搞个决定版把奴隶膝盖搞坏了是吧？ 9.射石机会打死自己人，还会把城墙搞矮，原版我就很讨厌这个设定，当然你说你要搞成游戏特性也行，但我寻思为什么AI射石机打自己城堡就啥事没有？导致AI用射石机可以瞎几把乱砸，玩家就不行，搞笑呢。 10.游戏任务时间巨他妈不合理，想要最好的评价一开始是十分钟二十分钟这个样子，你们到底玩没玩过游戏就发售了？这样赚钱吗？你以为是玩家们不给你赚钱吗？这样恶心人，根本没玩过自己做的东西就端上来，厨师都要吃一下东西行不行才端上来，你们玩都不玩就端上来？ 11.那么多BUG不好好打磨搞好，不好好更新特性，来点2025的先进机制，就想着要出DLC搞公告了，做的AI更是一坨屎，666 总之萤火虫你要是不愿意好好做，不如继续回去打磨你的要塞3和要塞军阀，我都不知道满脑子想的是什么，大家不仅冲着情怀来，也是觉得决定版可以做得很好，可以有2025年的水平，你说你工作室小做不到微软那种大公司的水平也可以理解，这些BUG和特性都解决不了吗？要塞十字军东征那么好的题材做好了就是能大卖特卖，即使现在那么多问题照样还大卖特卖，一点都不理解吗？有钱亏要塞3和要塞军阀，没钱搞好十字军东征？草你吗的，十几年的玩家真他妈的无语，从一开始的无语马上变成愤怒，就这还卖76，就算不首周折扣，如果你做的好，76冲着十几年情怀也买了，结果做的跟什么一样你自己看看你做的东西

就目前而言，我并不推荐购入，想玩的可以直接上手原版，决定版和原版的区别可以说是过大于过。 第一：很经典的位置不合理，玩家的位置有绿洲必没石头，有石头必没绿洲，从远处运过来效率特别低，我以为决定版可以加一些升级工具增加运输效率或者把以前的任务修改一下，但还是老一套，毫不客气地说，几乎就是把以前的代码复制粘贴过来就能卖了，看不到一点新意。 第二：难度提升靠垃圾时间，给你2000块，然后慢慢去和四个哈里发打吧。新出的哨站也是个脑残，老鼠AI靠哨站能暴30多个剑士，无敌了，这样加强是吧。没有任何新意，哪怕征程里你改成防守呢，比如防守半个小时的进攻，还能给你那几乎没用的城墙刷点战绩。 第三：AI不合理，虚空黄金我就不吐槽了，我真的不知道AI的钱怎么刷出来的。而且队友AI屁用没有，只会找玩家要物资，然后攒一波兵去送，玩家找他们要物资死都不给，我亲眼看见老鼠AI攒了9000多钱，找他要1000钱暴兵死活不给，玩家在前线热火朝天，AI在后方攒彩礼留着娶老婆，我玩你个乌木青 第四：新出的兵种也没吊用，走得慢伤害低价格贵，通关方式依旧是20年前的老套路，就是链锤加弓骑打快攻或者人海，除了这两个兵种之外其他都可以删了，弩手守家有用留着！唯一值得称赞的就是出了女领主。另外加的四个领主也是一言难尽，一个不修城墙，一个强度不如小胖（女祭司），一个强度超标（不知道圣殿骑士哪来的钱疯狂暴重甲，直接平推全场，没有操作全是数值），一个直接查无此人（明珠甚至还不如菲利普，人家菲利普好歹还知道寇可来我亦可往，她被打了只会拉更多部队出来挨打）。 第五：是我鼠标有问题吗，我选取了部队后它能给我自动取消，我把部队拉到前线它能中途跑回集结点，操作部队点击敌人的时候也会被强制取消，然后部队走人家脸上，我玩原版从来没有这种问题。 第六：时代变了，2025年的节奏很快，制作组可以试着加强AI的逻辑而不是靠数值拖时间，没人希望花半个小时以上慢慢去磨AI的城堡，玩家是来玩游戏的，不是来受累的，一局下来这么折磨干嘛不去飞叶子。我说白了，你把玩家和AI的钱换一下，10分钟能开9把征程干掉8个狮心王7个野狼顺手踩死其他6个减速带还能剩500块买4个马厩3个粮仓加上2个猪鼻队友开1把中世纪无限制格斗大赛。

犹记得当时要塞本体玩得差不多后，我在网上零星看到消息，才知道资料片《十字军东征》已经推出了。那时候网络条件极差，上网特别贵。电脑得插上调制解调器（俗称“猫”），用电话线拨号连接，吱吱呀呀奇异声响半天，ok了，连接成功上网。那会每小时网费加电话租费加起来高达六块钱。为了便宜点，我专门去街上买了张包月上网卡，用卡上特定的账号密码拨号连接上网，这样每小时网费据说能降到一块钱，但电话租费还得另外算的。 当时为了下载这个游戏原版，我清晰地记得安装包都要442MB，在那时简直是“巨无霸”级别。我就半夜等父母睡熟后，用“专业手法”无声息开门，偷偷溜进他们房间把电话线顺过来，插进自己电脑的“猫”口，再用古老的下载工具“网际快车”，以6KB到20KB的蜗牛般速度断点续传，整整下了六天七夜才终于搞定。 之后几天我还是照常偷偷上网，我爸一开始只是警觉地把电话线拔掉，后来忍无可忍，直接拿剪刀把电话线咔嚓给剪断了。结果下个月我爸去缴纳话费，账单竟然高达六百八十多块。。实在太夸张了。。 直到多年后的现在，《要塞：十字军东征》居然出了决定版，真的太惊喜了。这代决定版全面强化，还是那个熟悉的味儿。官方还推出了新阵营、新战役、新AI领主，最高难度玩起来特别有意思。最为意外是遭遇战也这么好玩的，新增了很多关卡，设计得非常用心。以前原版受限于当时电脑性能，敌方出兵数量很少。现在新出个前哨站，则是无穷无尽的敌人朝我的要塞涌来，先守城再转攻城，节奏紧张刺激的很。之后官方承诺秋冬季还会更新AI领主和更多地图关卡，全部玩完可以玩上很久时间，物超所值，越陈的酒越香醇！

This game advertises, that you can have an army up to 10,000 people, but in a game with 8 players involved, the game will just tell you, that you reached the maximum army size at around 300 people. Realizing this fact and bringing it to attention, will just get you banned from their community page and pretended, like this issue never happened. Same goes to other things, like Moat diggers randomly stop digging moats near trees or archers keep on shooting in front of a target instead of shooting their target.

I really had high hopes that Firefly would fix at least some of the AI-breaking bugs, but with the latest DLC, all my hope has vanished. Here are just a few examples: - The AI does not target the enemy Lord after breaching the castle walls, instead focusing on destroying the economy. - The AI fails to replace fallen castle defenders, recruiting patrol units instead and leaving towers unoccupied as the game progresses. - Backup troops do not retreat after a failed siege, preventing the AI from recruiting a new siege army during that time. These are only a few examples—there are many more bugs that Firefly seems unlikely to fix. If you just want to play the campaign or the skirmish trails and have some fun, then the game is absolutely worth it. However, if you're like me and interested in creating your own CPU Lords and pitting them against other community-made CPUs, you're likely to encounter a lot of frustration due to these persistent AI issues.

Stronghold Crusader, but in Definitive Edition. A game of childhood memory. It's exactly as I remember it. Like, seriously, it's the same simple RTS it was 20 years ago. Units are still unbalanced as they were and gameplay improvements is laughable. Wall and moat mazes work like always. Fire is still too powerful. Horse Archers, especially paired with Mantlets, are still the fastest and cheapest option to clear castles. If you knew how to play then, you will know how to play now. Firefly slapped new coat of paint, threw few new Bedouin units to the mix and called it a success, because people bought it out of nostalgia. Then also added female representation to the game. Like, Camel Lancers clearly being women because of thier voice, but community quickly caught them on that. Old Stronghold Crusader had 0 female lords or units. Now we have like 4, and every single one of them is using this annoying and loud death scream hurting my ears. It's a game about castles, stop ruining my nostalgia with crap. Then they releasec CPU editor in state of "Waste 7 days to build Rat's castle.", because editor lacked basic functions. My personal favourite is the stairs placement being reversed in editor. Community called out multiple issues on the game and editor, myself included, but they ain't fixed. Enough is enough. I am not going to waste multiple days to do workarounds in the editor to make my very own CPU Lord actually work, just to be forced to upload videos and dialogue lines to different sites, because Firefly is too scared people will make a certain Austrian Painter with very small stache a CPU lord. Firefly failed to provide with the game and the service. Nostalgia is not worth that much. If you want to play it then just download old Stronghold Crusader and install yourself Unofficial Crusader Patch (UCP). It's much more enjoyable experience. Now I wonder if I can get a refund on this...

What appeared to be a labor of love at first, slowly but surely turned out to be a nostalgia cash grab. While I love the game, I simply can't recommend it due to the way Firefly treats their playerbase. Why? Because instead of addressing game breaking issues, they'll rather release more totally unnecessary DLCs - to grab more cash. The issues we as the community report to them won't even get acknowledged. I know, because I reached out to them myself over every existing way possible, from their Discord to Steam Discussions to their own support website. All that happened is that they closed down the Discord bug section. Yay And we're not talking small issues like the abysmal AI performance (which it still is) or their design decision of increasing difficulty by placing unit spawners everywhere in the new trails and koop trails (which turns every mission into a simple rush-the-spawner-and-win experience). Both of that can be avoided by using workshop content, which is largely better than Fireflys stuff. (although the custom trail editor is also super bugged and for some reason they simply won't allow us to make co-op trails? Presumably so their own trails remain aren't getting completly overshadowed by community content) We're talking problematic bugs that affect all, custom lords, vanilla lords, vanilla lord reworks. And the issues simply don't get even acknowledged. And there's so many. I'll just name a few. - The knight weapon bug where AI lacks horses to recruit knights and now simply buys random weapons, reaching the sell threshold of these and selling them again, basically throwing money into the void. Affecting vanilla and custom lords all the same, also the reason why the Marshall is the weakest vanilla lord now. - The hop spam bug where hop farms do not work as normal farms. Firefly thought they were smart and simply capped hop farms at 5 if there's other farms to be built. Still makes farm population super unpredictable, especially annoying for workshop creators. - The unified movement spead for grouped unit types. Units slow down to a marching speed when sent together even though all selected units could actually move way faster. An annoying micro challenge for players (you basically have to use all units seperately), but a huge issues for AIs. This screws a lot with the freedom of designing custom lords, but also affects Fireflys designs. E.g. the Sergeant is supposed to do really fast raids with skirmishers and macemen, but since the AI sends both unit types together they walk really slow in marching speed, making his raids really weak. - Capped amount of ox tethers for AIs per quarry. AI builds a maximum of 3 ox tethers for a quarry, which means if the stone is far away, that's a terrible situation. And at the same time AI can only build 10 tethers all together. Now take vanilla lords like the Wolf, who builds 6 quarries, and you realise that there's a very big flaw clearly visible right there. And no, none of these numbers can be adjusted with the editor - because why would an editor for AI lords allow to adjust the behavior of AI lords, lol Also the custom lords and lord extensions for vanilla lords are still implemented in a super unsatisfactory way, even though it's been a major selling point for the game. Custom lords only do media over third party options (e.g. downloading it on Nexus and setting it up yourself), giving them 8 different titles and descriptions ingame just isn't possible at all. (edit 1.6.2026: they actually gave us a way to do the 8 titles now, months after everyone complained, so I'd call that progress IF IT WEREN'T FOR THE FACT EVERY OTHER ISSUE STILL REMAINED UNACKNOWLEDGED) Vanilla lord edits have to be uploaded and downloaded to the workshop one by one. So if you were to adjust the lords behavior and adjust all of his 8 basic castles, that's a total of 9 workshop items to be uploaded and downloaded for everyone using them. For the 16 OG characters that means a total of 144 workshop items. But since we're not just at 16 lords anymore but a total of 29 (that is including all DLCs, even the summer one not yet released), you would need a total of 261 workshop items to overhaul them all. I simply can't understand how this was deemed okay to set up like this. So yeah, unless actually starts fixing their issues and treating their fanbase better, don't buy the game. Or if you already bought the game, hold out on the DLCs.

As someone who has played the Stronghold games for as long as I can remember—and still owns the original CDs—I was excited about a refreshed Crusader. Unfortunately, this Definitive Edition feels more like a reheated product than a true upgrade. While having Crusader, Extreme, and DE all in one package is convenient, it doesn't offer much beyond new skirmish trails. The new units are a neat addition, but they rarely feel necessary. Unless you are intentionally trying to challenge yourself, the standard European garrison remains your best and most efficient choice, making the new variety somewhat pointless. Worse yet, many of the original bugs are still present. Honestly, the classic standard Crusader enhanced with community mods still offers a better, more stable experience. At full price, this is a hard pass. Keep playing the modded original and wait for at least a 50% discount before picking this up. Leaving a negative review for now. EDIT: Few days after writing that review, it was announced the development has been stopped and the whole team of SC:DE is switching to another project, leaving the game buggy to the point it makes really hard to enjoy the game. If you want to get a good experience from playing, stay with the Crusader HD, download Unofficial Community Patch and enjoy. This one is a waste of money.
